text: Volcano plots one well known used plots display differentially expressed genes. functions return basic ggplot object including important parts creating volcano plot.  , overview key parameters: res_de: DESeqResults mapping: annotation/species: Important generate symbols labeling. labeled_genes: number top DE genes labeled. Default 30. logfc_cutoff FDR: draw lines plot genes mark significant. default 1 (meaning L2FC +/-1): genes FoldChange higher 1 lower -1 padj value 0.05. plot can later modified user, like regular ggplot object. example:  possibilities please look ggplot2 documentation. addition focusing differentially expressed genes, volcano plot user can also highlight genes associated certain GO term interest. can done go_volcano() function:  key parameters: res_de: DESeqResults res_enrich: enrichment results term_index: index(row) term interest located enrichment result. logfc_cutoff FDR: draw lines plot genes mark significant. default one (meaning L2FC +/-1): genes FoldChange higher 1 lower -1 padj value 0.05. mapping: annotation/species: Important generate symbols labeling. n_overlaps: number overlaps ggrepel supposed allow labeling (increases number labeled genes). col_to_use: Name column res_de containing gene symbols. enrich_col: Name column res_enrich containing gene symbols. example see run_topGO data provided mosdef: data(res_enrich_macrophage_topGO, package = "mosdef"). down_col: Colour downregulated genes (genes logfc_cutoff value specified). up_col: Colour upregulated genes (genes logfc_cutoff value specified). highlight_col: Colour genes associated given term interest.
